description: This file defines a generic class 'ConcurrentLoadGenerator<TState>' used for generating concurrent load in performance testing scenarios. It manages multiple worker tasks that issue requests, collect timing and success/failure metrics, and produce reports on throughput and failures.

classes.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator<TState>
classes.description: A class for generating and managing concurrent load for performance testing, supporting warmup, run, and reporting functionalities.

methods.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the load generator with parameters for concurrency, request blocks, and request functions.

methods.name: Warmup
methods.description: Performs a warmup run to initialize resources and ignore warmup metrics.

methods.name: ResetBetweenRuns
methods.description: Resets the internal channel used for collecting completed work blocks.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the load test, manages worker tasks, collects results, and outputs performance reports.

methods.name: PrintReport
methods.description: Generates a string report summarizing the collected work blocks, including throughput and failure counts.

methods.name: RunWorker
methods.description: Performs a worker loop issuing requests and recording timing and success/failure metrics.
